body_wall: Complete closed-weave hollow wall with separate inner shading, no lid or baked inventory.
handle_join: Loop ends continue into sidewall; two bound reed loops at each foot visibly tie them to the rim/wall.
authored_dimensions: Hidden depth/wall thickness/strand count are authored; common frame and source low-bowl/tall-loop proportions retained.

weave.actual_wall_fit: Deterministic evaluated outer-wall cross sections, alternating over/under displacement, real strand thickness.
weave.openings: Close-woven foundation remains continuous; no inventory contents or unrelated floating marks.

source_selection: Direct Blender neutral reeds, bound loop/rim and contours preserve shape and weave. No ImageGen or isolation call.
production_view: south only; east/north retained as actual common-frame authoring views, not added native direction states.

weave_fit_correction.method: Intersect evaluated bowl mesh edges with each strand-height plane and take the outer normalized elliptical radius. No directional ray can tunnel through a mesh seam or select the far wall.
